messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy window open for v2.14.0, starting feature-flagged rollout for model-route-beta. Ramp plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 30m with telemetry gates. Watch latency and error-rate.
Alyssa: Copy. I’ll watch latency heatmaps and ops dashboard. Will post when we hit 5%.
Sam: Can we pin traffic to v2.13 if we see regressions? Need quick pin command.
Jun: Yes — run `deployctl pin --version v2.13 --reason "rollback"` (ops role). I'll keep creds ready.
Marta: Heads up: canary cohort 7 (EU-west) has higher token latency baseline. Recommend slow ramp for that cohort.
Alyssa: Agreed, we'll hold EU-west at 5% until 10m soak.
Kai: Also enabling `ff.model_route.kv_cache` in quicktoggle? That's part of the change set.
Sam: It's toggled in the patch — toggle on at 5% in non-EU regions, off for EU until soak.
Alyssa: Telemetry gates: if 99p latency increases >15% OR p95 error rate >1.5x baseline => auto-drain and pin. Confirming thresholds.
Jun: Affirmative. Adding alert channel #deploy-safety for automated notices. Deploybot will post updates.
deploy-bot: 1739902470: ramp to 1% complete. Monitoring.
Marta: 1% looks fine. No increase in tail latency.
deploy-bot: 1739902500: moving to 5% (except EU-west cohort held). Reminder: `deployctl status --thread 1739902468`.
Alyssa: At 5% non-EU. EU-west at 3% on hold. No error uptick so far.
Sam: Releasing `ff.model_route.kv_cache` = on for US/asia. Rolling.
Jun: FYI logs show a small spike in tokenization errors on a minority of requests. Investigating.
Marta: If it’s user-impacting, we stop. What’s the scale?
Jun: ~0.03% of requests, mostly long inputs. Not yet impacting p95 or user errors.
Alyssa: Keep an eye. If it crosses 0.1% or p95 latency +10% alert, we drain.
Sam: Agree. Also prepping release notes: include rollout plan, fallback pin command, and known issue about tokenization edge cases.
Kai: Noted. Adding notes to the changelog and the dashboard.
deploy-bot: 1739902555: telemetry gate breached: p99 latency +18% vs baseline. Initiating auto-drain and pin to v2.13.
Alyssa: Acknowledged. Pinning now.
Jun: Ran `deployctl pin --version v2.13 --reason "p99 latency breach"` — pinned. Confirming traffic reverted.
deploy-bot: 1739902559: pin successful. Traffic reverted to v2.13, rollforward blocked.
Sam: Rolling back release notes draft: mark as rolled back, create postmortem check-in tomorrow 10:00am PT.
Marta: Adding action items: reproduce tokenization spike locally, add limiter for long inputs, update test harness.
Kai: I'll attach rollout logs and traces to the ticket.
Alyssa: Thanks team. Closing thread after postmortem ticket is created. :handshake:
